title: The Breath Where Silence Learns to Rise

features.name: rising column
features.desc-on-touch: You feel the weight lift. Silence ascends here, carrying every unspoken word it once held.

features.name: spiral echo
features.desc-on-touch: The spiral traces paths in the dark—each turn unwinding another layer of what silence kept.

features.name: humming void
features.desc-on-touch: A single tone emerges from emptiness. Silence has learned that voice was always possible.

features.name: pale drift
features.desc-on-touch: Motes drift upward like the memory of breath, made visible only by the darkness around it.

inscription: here breath learned that silence has always had a way out; it rises now, carrying every word that never needed saying

file.name: Breath_Ascending_Evening_Recording.mp3
file.note: Wind passing through a space so still it sounds like the first sound ever made.
